records.title: Where the Time Goes: Analysis of a Public LLM Serving System
records.reason: The author-affiliated IT University of Copenhagen record provides the paper abstract: analysis of 337K public LLM-serving requests finds queuing often drives TTFT, large/small models can have similar user latency, and request features poorly predict outputs, constraining arrival-time scheduling. Direct ACM DOI page returned 403; the institution record is first-party metadata and abstract.

records.title: Influence-Inspired Spectral Rotations for Extreme Low-Bit LLM Quantization
records.reason: The primary arXiv abstract applies influence-inspired spectral rotations and reconstruction-error quantization to low-bit LLM weights, reports perplexity gains at W2A16, and exports quantized weights for NPU/GPU/CPU execution.

records.title: Optimal Brain Restoration for Joint Quantization and Sparsification of LLMs
records.reason: The primary arXiv abstract introduces training-free second-order error compensation to align LLM pruning and quantization; it reports up to 4.72x speedup and 6.4x memory reduction against FP16 dense models.

records.title: SpinOut: Enhanced Rotation-Based Quantization for LLM by Outlier Injection
records.reason: The official IEEE Xplore abstract describes SpinOut rotation-matrix training with selective outlier injection for LLM quantization; it reports improved quantization quality and reduced calibration samples/iterations. Publisher search result exposed the abstract; direct page required JavaScript verification.

records.title: Why Attention Patterns Exist: A Unifying Temporal Perspective Analysis
records.reason: The primary arXiv abstract analyzes temporal attention patterns in LLMs and applies its insight to KV-cache compression and pruning, with improved performance over baselines.

records.title: Rope to Nope and Back Again: A New Hybrid Attention Strategy
records.reason: The primary arXiv abstract proposes hybrid local/global attention for long-context language models and reports efficiency gains during both training and inference.

records.title: CHERRY: Compressed Hierarchical Experts with Recurrent Representational Yield
records.reason: The primary arXiv abstract describes recurrent representation reuse/compression that reduces a 48-layer model to six unique blocks near dense-model parity and reports serving a 122B adapted model on one 120GB accelerator.

records.title: NIKA: Optimal KV Cache Transfer for Minimizing the Latency of Disaggregated LLM Inference
records.reason: The official SciTePress abstract proposes using decode-GPU residual capacity to trade KV-cache transfer for recomputation in disaggregated LLM inference; it reports up to 54% lower TTFT without throughput loss.

records.title: Joint Effects of GPU Server Topology, Parallelism, and Congestion Control on MoE Inference: A Controlled Simulation Study
records.reason: The primary arXiv abstract presents controlled MoE inference simulations varying GPU topology, parallelism, collectives, and congestion control, and quantifies their impacts on exposed communication and completion time.

records.title: Joint Fine-tuning and Conversion of Pretrained Speech and Language Models towards Linear Complexity
records.reason: The primary arXiv abstract converts pretrained transformer speech/language models toward linear-time architectures through cross-architecture distillation and evaluates retention of inference capability on language and speech tasks.

records.title: Do Vision Transformers Need All-to-All Attention? Global Communication Through Elastic Learned Cores
records.reason: The primary abstract is specifically about Vision Transformers on image classification and dense-prediction tasks; it provides no LLM, language inference, or serving connection.

records.title: Mitigating Quantization Errors Due to Activation Spikes in Gated Linear Unit-Based Large Language Models
records.reason: The official MDPI publisher abstract identifies GLU activation spikes as a quantization-error source in LLM feed-forward layers and proposes selective methods that improve quantized accuracy and reduce latency. Search-visible publisher abstract was available; direct page returned HTTP 429.

records.title: Understanding Evaluation Illusion in Diffusion Large Language Models
records.reason: The primary arXiv abstract rigorously evaluates diffusion-LLM decoding methods across prompt templates and exposes sensitivity in reported inference-efficiency gains, making this a direct benchmark/evaluation contribution to decoding efficiency claims.

records.title: Screening Is Enough
records.reason: The primary arXiv abstract proposes threshold-based screening attention; it reports robust long-context retrieval and lower model-side time-to-first-token with greater parameter efficiency.

records.title: Privacy-Aware Split Inference with Speculative Decoding for Large Language Models over Wide-Area Networks
records.reason: The primary arXiv abstract presents privacy-aware split LLM inference over WANs with lookahead speculative decoding, reporting measured throughput and local-memory requirements.

records.title: DEL: Context-Aware Dynamic Exit Layer for Efficient Self-Speculative Decoding
records.reason: The primary arXiv abstract introduces context-aware dynamic exit-layer/speculation-length selection for self-speculative decoding and reports 2.16x–2.62x speedups over autoregressive decoding.

records.title: TaskPress: Query-Agnostic KV Cache Compression via Task-Guided Pruning
records.reason: The primary arXiv abstract presents task-guided reusable KV-cache pruning for long-context inference, using quantization scales to identify influential tokens.

records.title: Context-Aware Assistant Selection for Improved Inference Acceleration with Large Language Models
records.reason: The primary arXiv abstract frames assistant-model selection as a contextual bandit and reports accelerated LLM generation from choosing aligned draft models across domains.
